fusions.name: Springboard Lash
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Leaping Nits
fusions.desc: Flicks a nit from your hair that deals 3 damage to the first enemy it meets, then jumps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that.

fusions.name: Slack and Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps you along a strand 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Infestation
fusions.desc: Every hit you land drops a flea from your hair onto that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all bite at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per flea (136% at full). Unfed, a flea drops off every 4 seconds.
